The American National Song-Book

’Tis the praise of Columbia awakens the song, / And the loud trump of Fame shall re-echo the strain; / America’s freedom the theme shall prolong, / And the world shall repeat it again and again.

The Praise of

Columbia

The American National Song-Book

Songs, Odes, and Other Poems, on National Subjects In Three Volumes

Compiled from Various Sources by William McCarty

The 786 selections, mostly by unknown authors, record in song and rhyme the popular sentiments of the Revolution and early American martial pride.
